_about: How the gap reporter asks Mum for what the engine lacks (engine-design § 10; rule G11): a natural English situation, never a table. English for grown-ups only (Mum's sheet), never shown to the child. {gloss} and {glossPl} come from the lexicon entry; a rule gap uses the rule's own `elicit` sentences from abstract.json.

templates.lexeme: How do you say "{gloss}"? Please say it in a short sentence, e.g. "bring me the {gloss}".

templates.feature.gender: One {gloss}, two {glossPl}. (Or: "I'd like some {gloss}, please", said politely.)
templates.rule: Please say these the way you would at home:
